display.purpose: Hero name and page titles only — one per view.

label.purpose: Kickers, dates, tags, nav, terminal chrome.

shadows.name: accent-focus-ring
shadows.purpose: State-only cyan glow on the current/hovered timeline node and focused elements.

shadows.name: hero-wash
shadows.value: radial-gradient(48rem 36rem at 88% -8%, color-mix(in oklch, var(--accent) 12%, transparent), transparent 60%)
shadows.purpose: Single faint cyan atmosphere bloom on the page shell. Never a card shadow.

shadows.name: terminal-window-lift
shadows.purpose: The one sanctioned dark drop shadow: floats the homepage tmux window. Never reuse on cards/buttons.

motion.name: rise
motion.value: @keyframes rise { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(12px) } to { opacity: 1; transform: none } }
motion.purpose: Default entrance; staggered across list items.

components.name: Section Kicker
components.description: Lowercase mono comment that marks every section. The site's named section grammar.
components.css: .ds-kicker { margin: 0 0 1rem; font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 0.75rem; letter-spacing: 0.06em; color: var(--accent-soft); }

components.name: Tag
components.description: Quiet mono pill for skill/tech lists. Texture, not a button — no hover.
components.css: .ds-tag { display: inline-block; padding: 0.18rem 0.62rem; font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 0.68rem; letter-spacing: 0.01em; color: var(--muted); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 999px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: The only button language — transparent cyan-outlined pill for the primary action.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { padding: 0.5rem 1.05rem; font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 0.7rem; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--accent); background: transparent; border: 1px solid color-mix(in oklch, var(--accent) 40%, transparent); border-radius: 999px; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 0.16s ease, background 0.16s ease, color 0.16s ease; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { color: var(--ink); border-color: var(--accent); background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--accent) 14%, transparent); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Nav Link
components.description: Mono uppercase nav item; cyan underline on hover/active.
components.css: .ds-nav-link { padding: 0.2rem 0; font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 0.72rem; letter-spacing: 0.1em; color: var(--muted); border-bottom: 1px solid transparent; transition: color 0.16s ease, border-color 0.16s ease; } .ds-nav-link:hover { color: var(--ink); border-color: var(--accent); }

components.name: Metric Highlight
components.description: Wraps the one number/outcome in a sentence. The visual thesis of the site.
components.html: cutting build + test cycles from 30 → 5 minutes.

components.name: Timeline Node
components.description: Dot on a 1px spine; the current/active node lights up cyan with a state glow.
components.css: .ds-node { display: inline-block; width: 9px; height: 9px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--bg); border: 2px solid var(--faint); } .ds-node--current { border-color: var(--accent); box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px color-mix(in oklch, var(--accent) 20%, transparent); }

components.name: Blog Post Prose
components.description: Long-form reading styles for slotted Markdown on the Base shell. Brighter ink for sustained reading; cyan links and list markers; inline code chip.
components.html: Same records. The 10-minute download is now 30 seconds. Inline duckdb reads it instantly.
components.css: .ds-prose { --prose-ink: oklch(0.87 0.012 95); font-size: 1.06rem; line-height: 1.72; color: var(--prose-ink); max-width: 42rem; } .ds-prose strong { color: var(--ink); font-weight: 700; } .ds-prose :not(pre) > code { font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 0.86em; padding: 0.1em 0.38em; border-radius: 4px; background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--ink) 10%, transparent); color: var(--ink); }

narrative.overview: The site should feel like Colin's own machine booted up in a dark room: a warm near-black surface, precise monospace chrome, and a single cyan signal that only ever lights up the thing that matters. It is engineer-native without cosplay — the homepage runs a literal terminal session, and every other page inherits that machine's language (mono // labels, the warm-neutral ramp, one cyan accent) without re-staging the whole terminal. Confident and a little playful; the work — real metrics, real systems — does the talking, not adjectives. This system rejects the faceless blog-starter default and the cream/beige editorial-restraint background. Warmth comes from the near-black hue and the display type, never from a tinted-paper body.
keyCharacteristics: Dark-only, warm near-black (--bg OKLCH L 0.165, hue 80) — never pure black, never light.
Exactly one chromatic color: cyan. Everything else is a warm-neutral ramp.
Big Bricolage Grotesque display against small JetBrains Mono technical chrome.
The metric is the accent: numbers/outcomes glow cyan, prose stays muted.
The literal terminal metaphor is scarce — reserved for the homepage.
Nav, content, and footer share a 1440px spine and line up.

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Cyan is the only hue on the page and marks the single most important element in view. Keep it under ~10% of any screen; its rarity is the whole point. Never introduce a second accent hue.

rules.name: The Metric Is The Accent Rule
rules.body: In prose, the number or outcome gets --accent-soft; the surrounding sentence stays --muted. Titles are muted at rest and shift to --ink only on hover.

rules.name: The // Kicker System
rules.body: Sections are marked with a lowercase mono comment — // experience, // writing — in --accent-soft or --muted. This is the deliberate named section grammar, NOT the banned all-caps tracked eyebrow. Keep it lowercase and comment-prefixed; never swap for 01/02 numbered markers.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: No drop shadows on cards, buttons, or inputs. Depth is tonal layering plus 1px hairlines. Exactly two shadows are allowed: the cyan state glow (hover/focus/current) and the homepage terminal window's ambient lift.

dos: Do keep the palette to the warm-neutral ramp plus one cyan. Body text ≥ 4.5:1, large/bold ≥ 3:1.
Do put the metric in --accent-soft and leave the sentence --muted — the number is the accent.
Do mark sections with the lowercase // kicker system.
Do pair big Bricolage Grotesque display with small JetBrains Mono chrome; keep display tracking ≥ −0.04em.
Do align nav, content, and footer on the 1440px spine.
Do provide a prefers-reduced-motion fallback for every animation; keep the cyan glow reserved for state.
donts: Don't use the cream / beige / paper editorial-restraint background, or any light theme. Warm near-black, dark-only.
Don't treat monospace as costume. The full terminal metaphor is homepage-only — don't cosplay a terminal on other pages.
Don't add a second accent hue, gradient text, or background-clip: text.

Don't use cards as the default container, nested cards, or colored border-left/right side-stripes on cards, list items, callouts, or alerts (the prose blockquote's 2px cyan left rule is the sole exception).
Don't add drop shadows on cards/buttons/inputs; the only shadows are the cyan state glow and the homepage terminal window's ambient lift.
Don't over-round: the terminal window caps at 14px, chips/buttons/nodes are full pills, everything else stays ≤ 7px. Never 16-32px.
Don't ship the generic SaaS/Bootstrap/AI-blog-starter default look.
